editorial:
Black Manta is back and angrier than ever, hunting Aquaman with a cursed weapon that could destroy Atlantis. Arthur Curry now rules the underwater kingdom while juggling fatherhood, and he has to team up with his locked-up brother Orm to stop the threat. The movie leans hard into big, colorful action and a buddy-comedy vibe between the two brothers. You get giant sea creatures, glowing underwater cities, and plenty of jokes mixed with the fights.

The action scenes are loud and fun, though some of the CGI looks a bit rough in spots. Jason Momoa brings his usual charm, and the brother dynamic gives the story some heart. It is not perfect, but it delivers a solid popcorn adventure. If you enjoyed the first film, you will likely have a good time here.
endingExplained: In the final battle, Arthur and Orm fight Black Manta, who is possessed by the Black Trident's evil spirit. Arthur manages to break the trident, freeing Manta from its control, but Manta refuses help and falls into a volcanic crack, seemingly dying. Arthur then reveals Atlantis to the surface world at the United Nations, ending the kingdom's secrecy. Orm is pardoned and walks free, hinting at a new beginning for both brothers.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves big superhero adventures and underwater action.
